content:
The new Apple TV 4K is set to launch soon, expected to debut at an iPhone event in the coming weeks. Apple code discovered by MacRumors has also leaked, showing that a new Siri Remote will be unveiled alongside it.

macOS code mentions the next-generation Apple TV remote

Apple released several public and beta software updates yesterday, among which the macOS 26.7 RC version contains references to multiple unreleased products.

MacRumors cited an example, noting that a video showing the operation screen of AirPods with a camera was included.

The new Siri Remote, compatible with the Apple TV 4K, also appeared on this list of unreleased products. Here's a report from Juli Clover:

Mark Gurman previously reported that the upcoming hardware update will come with a 'possibly improved Apple TV remote'.

The discovery of this next-generation Siri Remote in macOS 26.7 indicates that the new remote will indeed launch this fall.

There are no rumors yet about what specific changes will be made. However, one common feature request is the ability to more easily locate a lost remote. Apple might incorporate the second-generation ultra-wideband chip used in AirTag 2 into the Siri Remote.

What changes would you like to see on the new Siri Remote for the next Apple TV 4K? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
